
# AI Development Instructions

This project is a Palia Mining Party Calculator built with Vue 3, Vite, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

- Use Vue 3 and JavaScript. Do not introduce TypeScript.
- Keep code simple, organized, and beginner-friendly.
- Preserve all existing functionality when making improvements.
- Keep the three mining locations: Bahari Bay, Elderwood, and Royal Highlands.
- Preserve customizable gemstone values and double points for star-quality gems.
- Make the application responsive and easy to use on computers and mobile devices.
- Maintain the existing dark, Palia-inspired design while improving usability.
- Avoid installing unnecessary libraries or dependencies.
- Explain important code changes in simple terms before implementing them.
- Test new features and verify that existing scoring calculations still work.
- Run npm run build to check for errors before deployment.
